Frequently asked questions

What is the price of a 1 BHK flat at Ashtavinayak Complex, Vangani?

1 BHK flats cost from ₹16.86 lakh (496 sq ft built-up) to ₹19.79 lakh (582 sq ft built-up).

What is the price of a 1 RK?

A 1 RK of 380 sq ft built-up costs ₹12.92 lakh.

What is the price of a 2 BHK?

2 BHK flats cost ₹23.39 lakh (688 sq ft built-up) and ₹26.45 lakh (778 sq ft built-up).

What do the shops cost?

Shops range from ₹12.27 lakh (172 sq ft built-up) to ₹18.25 lakh (270 sq ft built-up).

Is Ashtavinayak Complex RERA registered?

Yes. The MahaRERA registration number is PM1270002501104.

Where is Ashtavinayak Complex located?

At S. No. 163/1/A/3, Pashane Road, near Shiv Utsav Complex, Vangani (W), Thane. Vangani railway station and the Mumbai–Pune Highway are about 1.5 km away.

What is the booking amount?

The booking amount is ₹21,000.

What amenities does the complex have?

Gym, club house, swimming pool, kids play area, landscape garden, indoor games, community hall, temple, parking, CCTV surveillance, power backup and a security cabin.

How do I book a site visit?

Call or WhatsApp 9324249393.
